source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check the BMC heart beat LED on the board.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: The LED should be GREEN with flashing.

original_test_intent: Verify that the specified onboard BMC heartbeat LED is physically green and flashing while the BMC is operating.
original_method: A qualified operator locates the BMC heartbeat LED on the main board, observes its color and cadence for the project-defined interval, captures photos or video, and reviews unexpected logs.
manual_activity: A qualified operator must identify the onboard rather than PDB indicator and visually judge green color and repeating flash behavior. Software BMC health or heartbeat messages cannot prove the physical emitter.
required_inputs: Exact main-board revision and BMC heartbeat LED location
Permitted green-color and flashing cadence/tolerance plus observation duration
BMC operating/power state in which the criterion applies
Powered-chassis viewing/ESD procedure, qualified operator and evidence method
safety_requirements: Do not touch the board, connectors or powered components; stop if safe optical access is unavailable.
Use the platform chassis and ESD procedure for any open-chassis observation.
Retain pre/post BMC/host/SEL evidence and do not use it as a substitute for visual proof.
Stop on BMC fault, wrong-LED ambiguity, unsafe access or loss of recovery; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the LED map, cadence measurement worksheet and synchronized evidence timestamps.
Collect read-only BMC reachability, firmware, sensor and SEL/host health for correlation.
Analyze operator video timing if provided and report deviations without claiming the observation occurred.
engineer_actions: Supply board map, cadence tolerance, observation interval and safety procedure.
Safely observe and record the correct physical LED.
Review the combined evidence and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: No command can establish the source criterion; its no-command conclusion is applicable, but software health output is corroborative only.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain direct observation, preferably timestamped video long enough to calculate cadence; optionally correlate read-only BMC uptime/health.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Green flashing behavior and both five-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.status: RETAIN VISUAL METHOD WITH CADENCE EVIDENCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture a labeled continuous video of the mapped main-board LED for the specified interval and derive on/off timing from the recording while logging BMC health timestamps.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board, BMC and CPLD/LED-controller firmware versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project board service documentation and LED cadence specification.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes flashing measurable and distinguishes the main-board indicator from adjacent LEDs.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No source coverage loss; telemetry remains secondary.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board map, cadence tolerance, duration and safe access.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Video exposure or frame rate can distort color/cadence and must be chosen appropriately.

project_override_considerations: A project defines the acceptable cadence tolerance and viewing duration. These missing parameters affect readiness, not the MANUAL ONLY capability classification and not permanent BLOCKED status.
expected_evidence: SUT/main-board/BMC identity and annotated LED location
Owner-approved green/cadence tolerance and observation duration
Timestamped video or photos plus operator notes proving green flashing of the correct LED
Correlated BMC/host/SEL health and separate engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source procedure and criterion consistently target the main-board BMC heartbeat LED and green flashing. Missing cadence tolerance is an input, not a contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Safe operator access and a board map make the case executable. A manual physical observation is not itself BLOCKED.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Agree that no remote command can prove the LED; narrow the expected state to flashing green and require correct indicator identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agree with MANUAL ONLY and preserve its cadence and powered-access controls.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates visual acceptance, measurable cadence and corroborating BMC health while avoiding guessed specifications.

review_improvement: Defines how to distinguish and measure the correct onboard heartbeat without copying conclusions from the adjacent PDB LED case.
independent_technical_reasoning: The main-board BMC heartbeat is a physical oscillator indication whose color and temporal behavior are not necessarily exposed through management APIs. Because both identity and cadence must be visually verified, the core remains manual even though video analysis and log correlation can be automated.

no_automatic_retry: Perform one approved observation interval. If visibility, identity or cadence evidence is inadequate, preserve it and request engineer direction rather than reopening the chassis or cycling power automatically.
